environment.description: Same Ktor service deployed behind Cloudflare Enterprise with a Transform Rule on the zone that appends response headers. The transform rule (ID: tr_9f2a1b3c) is configured as a Modify Response Header action with operation 'set' on all responses matching URI path '/api/reports/*'. The header added is 'Content-Security-Policy' with value "default-src 'self'; script-src 'none'; style-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'". This is a zone-level rule that cannot be overridden by origin response headers due to Cloudflare's header priority model where Transform Rules execute after origin response but before delivery to client. The /tmp directory is mounted with tmpfs but with the container running under a non-root user (uid 1001) and the systemd PrivateTmp=true directive isolating the temp namespace per service unit.

config.cloudflare_zone: enterprise plan, transform rule tr_9f2a1b3c active
config.csp_enforcement: cloudflare transform rule, set operation, path match /api/reports/*
config.response_headers: cloudflare transform rule overrides origin CSP
